reviews.title: ​I order a SIM on 26th
reviews.body:
​I order a SIM on 26th, in the offer they said it will be with me next working day. After waiting for days and wasting both time and money relying on a SIM that never showed up, I contacted customer support again today to request a refund. Instead of offering a real solution, the agent simply asked me to wait again until Monday!
​Only after I firmly insisted on a refund did they process it, claiming it will take another 3 to 5 working days to reach my account.
​unfortunately, Lebara completely failed to deliver on their delivery promises and repeatedly misled me about when the SIM would arrive. Extremely disappointing customer service and experience—I definitely won't recommend them

reviews.title: The complaints team are absolutely…
reviews.body:
The complaints team are absolutely horrendous, considering these are the colleagues that have been employed to deal with complaints, you seriously need to review who has been employed.

Receiving a call about my complaint despite asking for a reply via email and no call to be made, I am then asked what is the complaint about - why did you not read the lengthy email I sent before you called me, then asking where my proof was of the reward - again why did you not read my email as the proof was there. How ill prepared can someone be in dealing with a customer complaint.

Then the abruptness of the colleague was appalling. 

All Lebara is interested in us closing the complaint. The complaint remains open and I have sent you a follow up complaint.

Sort your service out when dealing with customer complaints as you are the worst I have dealt with.

If the matter is not dealt with I will be escalating to the ombudsman..
